build_distributed_svg0_program: build a distributed SVG0 agent topology using launchpad with actors, learner, and evaluator nodes
create_svg0_learner: create an SVG0 learner that initializes online and target networks and trains from a replay dataset
create_svg0_actor: create an SVG0 actor that runs a policy network in an environment loop with a replay adder
create_svg0_evaluator: create an SVG0 evaluator that runs a deterministic policy network for evaluation in an environment loop
configure_svg0_replay: configure the SVG0 replay storage tables using the builder with environment spec and sequence length
